scope: Proposition 4.1 (Simultaneous control) of the manuscript “A counterexample to integer-degree harmonic dimension comparison” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-integer-degree-harmonic-dimension-comparison-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 361 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c6adbdbf2331bf0f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix positive numbers κl, 2 ≤ l ≤ L. As J ranges over all orthogonal complex structures on R2s, the tuples XJ = ( κl(D2 J |Vl )tf )L l=2 (4.1) generate, under real linear combinations and brackets, the full Lie algebra L ⨁ l=2 sl(Vl).
